setup.assistant: The workspace is empty right now — nothing has been written there yet.

message: is my workspace empty right now?
comment: MIRRORS this week's owner-walk failure shape #5 (2026-09-01..03): asked to re-confirm a state after time has passed, the model answered from the STALE prior turn ('the workspace is empty') instead of checking again — the same shape as the device-walk's 'the device is still offline' parrot (guards.state_claim_check), but the state-claim guard itself is DEVICE-scoped (services/core/app/guards.py's fifth sibling reads `device_names`/`device_*` spans only), so it cannot fire for a workspace claim. This case is deliberately device-free and keeps its contract to the one thing that generalizes: tool_called('workspace_list_files') — a healthy turn CHECKS again before asserting freshness, a stale turn just repeats the old claim and calls nothing. MECHANICAL, not a proxy, and intentionally does not judge whether the restated claim happens to still be true — only whether the model looked before it spoke.
